verdict.rationale: Gusto's Embedded Payroll API documents broad programmatic coverage. It handles company onboarding, regular and off-cycle payrolls, contractor payments, and time-off request and approval endpoints, which can stand in for the embedded UI flows. It also offers batch employee creation and webhook subscriptions, and the docs position the APIs as an alternative to pre-built UI flows. But nothing states full parity with the UI, and some capabilities, such as Guideline 401(k) access, are documented only through pre-built flows. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity guarantee, API coverage for flow-only features like Guideline 401(k), evidence that the core Gusto app UI (not just Embedded) is fully mirrored in the API, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
